name: IBPS PO (CRP PO/MT-XVI)
notes: Live photo via webcam/phone also required during registration, in addition to the uploaded photo. Also requires a left thumb impression (20-50KB, 240x240px, jpg, 3cm x 3cm) and a handwritten declaration (50-100KB, 800x400px, jpg, 10cm x 5cm) -- not yet modeled by this schema, which only covers photo and signature. Caps, hats, dark glasses not acceptable; religious headwear allowed if face uncovered. Signature not in capital letters.
source: IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI official notification, dated 01.07.2026, Annexure III (Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Documents), pp. 36-38. PDF on file (no stable public download URL captured yet; official site is www.ibps.in).
